name: Flood risk zone dataset
fact: 780,636 Environment Agency flood-risk-zone records; authoritative dataset, source snapshot last refreshed in 2023.
gate: Constraint only; exact parcel intersection required.

name: Flood risk level taxonomy
fact: Three authoritative flood-risk levels: 1, 2 and 3.
gate: Taxonomy only until exact site match.

name: Flood risk climate-change allowances
fact: EA guidance applies climate-change allowances by flood zone, vulnerability and management catchment, including future-risk cases currently in Zone 1.

name: Preparing a flood risk assessment: standing advice
fact: Updated 28 May 2026; covers FRA content, sequential/exception tests, floor levels, resilience and access.
gate: Guidance defines gates, not site outcome.

name: National flood risk standing advice for LPAs
fact: Updated 28 May 2026; sets FRA, drainage and EA-consultation triggers for LPAs.

name: Strategic flood risk assessment guidance
fact: Updated 28 May 2026; LPAs should prepare SFRAs covering present and future flood risk.
gate: Strategic evidence needs exact authority/site readback.

name: Listed building dataset

fact: 121,057 outlines; incomplete coverage and not consistently planning curtilage.

fact: 20,150 scheduled monuments; some platform data MHCLG-created pending replacement.

gate: General guidance is not parcel evidence.
